programmes.evidence: Official PhD in Management programme explicitly covers three broad domains Management, Marketing and Operations Management. The programme page identifies Operations and Supply Chain Management among its supervisory research groupings and explains four-year research training, initial MPhil registration and dissertation completion. Current October 2026 start displayed.
limitations: Operations Management is an explicit research domain within PhD in Management, not a separately titled Operations doctorate. No historic awarder or founding date inferred. January 2026 application deadline refers to October2026 intake, not permanent admission suspension.

branches.conclusion: Existing full-time PhD Management/Marketing/Operations Management route remains verified. Current Bayes Executive PhD overview confirms a separate four-year part-time PhD with broad Management and Finance training streams; the detailed Management and research-topics pages timed out on full open. Whether Operations Management is a formal named doctoral research area within that distinct Executive PhD remains unresolved, so no additional route is inferred.

Current City St George’s university-wide postgraduate research-course inventory and Engineering department page enumerate the complete named Engineering doctorates: Civil Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering and Aeronautics. Current Mathematics and Computer Science PhD pages list their named research areas; none has a formal Ops/MS/IE title. Maritime Operations and Management appears only as an MSc, not a doctorate. No other strict-title doctoral route evidenced beyond the existing Bayes programme.
